nodes.label: Borneo Jasa POS
nodes.rationale: Offline-first architecture ensures sales, stock, and credit tracking proceed without network connection at hardware retail counters.

nodes.label: packages/core
nodes.rationale: Pure domain module without I/O so pricing and order rules remain decoupled from database drivers.

nodes.label: packages/data
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates SQLite schema, migrations, and SqlPosRepo for both Electron better-sqlite3 and dev sql.js.

nodes.label: apps/pos
nodes.rationale: Desktop till combining Vue 3 UI and Electron main process with single IPC serialization.

nodes.label: Integer Cents and Milli-Units Precision
nodes.rationale: Prevents floating-point rounding issues by storing money in cents and measured quantities in integer milli-units; decimal.js is confined strictly to UI input/output boundaries.

nodes.label: Close Day Lifecycle and Sync
nodes.rationale: Business day boundaries close on manual action rather than midnight; exports Excel workbook and SQLite snapshot into an asynchronous Google Drive sync queue.

nodes.label: Renderer IPC Transaction Queue
nodes.rationale: Renderer writes share a single IPC queue to prevent concurrent operations from interleaving BEGIN and COMMIT statements.

nodes.label: 1080p Fixed Touchscreen Layout
nodes.rationale: Fixed 1920x1080 layout at 1x zoom with category rail, product grid, and cart designed for fast counter operation and multilingual Chinese/English/Malay labels.
